false_negatives.finding: The second weight request is admitted on the same edge as the first core accept because its guard uses core_after rather than the prior registered core count/stage. The promised strict request-after-accept order is not enforced.
The second response/core accept, psum commit, row completion and task completion may all occur on one edge and cascade through core_after, commit_after and row_after to W_TASK_DONE.

Tuple and child identities use ordinary four-state equality without $isunknown/case equality. An X source index, psum address, row id or task epoch makes !(condition) evaluate X, so the if body does not set the sticky fault while the event counter advances.

The static witness checker searches tokens rather than active bind expressions. Real response/row seams plus attack-mask/design-fault inputs can be tied to constants while required text remains in comments/port declarations.
The sole PASS display may be moved before the conditional fatal and still pass check_witness_text. A failing simulation could therefore print the unique PASS token before terminating.
The source checker does not validate the contract's 214912-byte ledger fields. Mutating represented/integrated/external bytes to 1/1/0 still returns PASS.

minimum_additive_successor: Advance only from registered stage_q/prior counts: second request requires stage_q==W_FIRST_ACCEPT at cycle entry; second accept requires W_SECOND_REQUEST; commit, row and task each require their immediately preceding registered stage. Explicitly document only the intended same-cycle groups (first weight+psum and response+core).
Reject unknown event controls and tuple/child identities with $isunknown and case equality before incrementing any counter.
Parse or exact-match active bind expressions for every real child output, attack mask and design/service fault; comments and declarations must not satisfy the checker.
Structure the final oracle as if (pass === 1'b1) PASS else fatal, and enforce that the sole PASS statement is control-dominated by the successful branch after the operand dump.
Validate the exact complete frozen_design ledger dictionary, including 214912 == 18432 + 196480, as well as source/checker/test/Python identities.
Retain the exact seven-member filelist and all already-working missing/duplicate/mask/fault attacks, then obtain a fresh different-author hammer before release.
